proposed_rules: Before coding new work, identify concrete missing behavior, existing canonical owner, relevant commit/test/evidence history, and why that behavior is not already implemented. Stale state labels, missing historical logs, cosmetic test combinations, and missing successors are insufficient to justify reopening completed work. Reopen only for specific reproduced defects, legitimate new findings, changed inputs invalidating prior proof, or explicit new user requirements.
